versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00177, SRS_Rte_00245 If an AtomicSwComponentType using a PortPrototype with an NvDataIn- terface invokes the explicit API Rte_Write and the attribute NvBlockDescrip- tor . supportDirtyFlag is set to true and the writing strategy storeAtShutDown ([SWS_Rte_04566] applies) is enabled, the RTE shall mark the associated RAM Block (s) as CHANGED by calling the NvM_SetRamBlockStatus function of the NvM module with the BlockChanged parameter set to true . The NvM_SetRamBlock- Status function shall be called by the RTE after the data accessed by the Rte_Write function is written back to the RAM Block (s).
